cars.summary: The Renault 21 2L Turbo is an established French sporting saloon of the late-1980s turbo era. Its road engine combined coordinated electronic ignition, injection and boost control with standard ABS, while the much more powerful Ragnotti racing derivative established the family’s touring-car heritage. One original 21 sporting family is counted, not ordinary saloons, Medallion badges, Quadra drivetrains, catalysed tunes, model years or racing evolutions as extra cars.

facts.title: Why this car belongs

Its road engine combined coordinated electronic ignition, injection and boost control with standard ABS, while the much more powerful Ragnotti racing derivative established the family’s touring-car heritage. One original 21 sporting family is counted, not ordinary saloons, Medallion badges, Quadra drivetrains, catalysed tunes, model years or racing evolutions as extra cars.
